python3 << 'EOF'
import math
import statistics

# National Defense expenditures (in millions) from Table 4
expenditures = {
    1933: 680,
    1934: 531,
    1935: 689,
    1936: 900,
    1937: 929,
    1938: 1029,
    1939: 1206,
    1940: 1657,
    1941: 6301  # Includes emergency ship construction from March 1941
}

# Calculate year-to-year log growth rates
years = sorted(expenditures.keys())
log_growth_rates = []
for i in range(1, len(years)):
    prev_year = years[i-1]
    curr_year = years[i]
    growth_rate = expenditures[curr_year] / expenditures[prev_year]
    log_growth = math.log(growth_rate)
    log_growth_rates.append(log_growth)
    print(f"{prev_year}-{curr_year}: {expenditures[prev_year]} -> {expenditures[curr_year]}, ratio={growth_rate:.4f}, log_growth={log_growth:.4f}")

print(f"\nLog growth rates: {log_growth_rates}")

# Calculate population standard deviation
mean = statistics.mean(log_growth_rates)
std_dev = statistics.pstdev(log_growth_rates)  # population standard deviation

print(f"Mean: {mean:.4f}")
print(f"Population Std Dev: {std_dev:.4f}")

# Coefficient of variation = std_dev / mean (absolute value for CV)
cv = abs(std_dev / mean)
print(f"Coefficient of Variation: {cv:.4f}")
print(f"Rounded to nearest hundredth: {round(cv, 2)}")
EOF

import math

# National Defense expenditures (in millions) from Table 4

    growth_rate = expenditures[curr_year] / expenditures[prev_year]
